title: A Statistical and Machine Learning Framework for Quantifying Offensive Impact in Professional Box Lacrosse
abstract: arXiv:2609.06610v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Professional box-lacrosse statistics summarize outcomes but provide limited information about shot quality or the roles behind scoring opportunities. This study develops a documented framework for estimating expected goals (xG) and attributing recorded offensive involvement using 1,006 manually annotated Rochester Knighthawks shot attempts, including 151 goals, from 13 consecutive 2025-2026 National Lacrosse League games. Logistic regression, random forest, and extremely randomized trees were evaluated across three nested feature sets using Leave-One-Game-Out cross-validation and a training-fold base-rate benchmark. The contextual baseline random forest had the lowest observed pooled log loss (0.4189) and Brier score (0.1260), improving on the benchmark by 1.22% and 1.50%; five of nine specifications did not beat the benchmark. Adding two-man-action and pick-type fields did not improve the primary metrics. Core Offensive Impact attribute

translated_title: 量化职业室内长曲棍球进攻影响力的统计与机器学习框架
translated_abstract: 职业室内长曲棍球的统计数据通常只汇总比赛结果，但对于射门质量以及得分机会背后球员角色的信息提供有限。本研究开发了一个有据可查的框架，用于估计预期进球数并归因进攻参与度，数据来自2025-2026赛季国家长曲棍球联盟（NLL）连续13场比赛中手动标注的1,006次Rochester Knighthawks队射门尝试，其中包括151个进球。研究采用留一比赛法交叉验证和训练折基准率基准，在三个嵌套特征集上评估了逻辑回归、随机森林和极端随机树三种模型。包含上下文基线的随机森林模型取得了最低的汇总对数损失（0.4189）和Brier评分（0.1260），相比基准分别提升了1.22%和1.50%；九种模型配置中有五种未能超越基准。添加二人配合动作和掩护类型字段并未改善主要评估指标。核心进攻影响力归因
tldr: 本研究利用手动标注的NLL职业室内长曲棍球射门数据，构建了估计预期进球并量化球员进攻参与贡献的统计与机器学习框架，发现包含上下文特征的随机森林模型表现最佳。
